record_title: Two visits identify a nonparametric closed binomial N-mixture
provenance: Distribution-free identification of visit-specific detection probabilities and the latent abundance law in the closed binomial repeated-count model, with a sharp one-visit versus two-visit boundary.
limitations: Requires a closed population, conditionally independent binomial visits, fixed visit-specific detection probabilities, positive finite mean abundance and finite second moment. Full-law identification is structural and may be ill-conditioned. An equivalent result may exist in older thinning or capture-count literature.
